data.desc: At the Heart of Amarin Corporation is a singular focus on advancing cardiovascular disease prevention worldwide. Our flagship oral prescription therapy, VASCEPA (icosapent ethyl or IPE), is the U.S. market leader across all available IPE products and has been prescribed more than 31 million times globally. Through our independent U.S. commercial operations and global commercial partnerships, Amarin supports access to VASCEPA/VAZKEPA across nearly 100 markets worldwide.
